title: 別れの最終電車
caption: 1960s Japanese mood kayo duet, slow and bittersweet. A deep male baritone crooner and a husky female alto trade lines in Japanese, then sing the chorus together in close harmony. Sobbing tenor saxophone, tremolo electric guitar, soft Latin-tinged brushed drums with a gentle beguine rhythm, upright bass, vibraphone, a quiet string section. Tender, resigned, two lovers parting on a station platform at night in the rain. Warm vintage studio sound with plate reverb.
lyrics:
[Intro - Saxophone]

[Verse 1 - Male]
時計の針が せかしてる
言えない言葉を 残したまま

[Verse 1 - Female]
ホームの端で うつむいて
私はベルを 待っている

[Chorus - Duet]
別れの最終電車
ドアが閉まれば それきりね
別れの最終電車
窓のしずくは 雨か涙か

[Verse 2 - Male]
幸せになれと 言いながら
本当は腕を 離せない

[Verse 2 - Female]
やさしい嘘は もういいの

[Chorus - Duet]

[Bridge - Duet]
